description: A site's pages by path, with their status, Google's coverage state and the last crawl and request. status not_indexed is every page that is neither indexed nor excluded; q matches part of the URL. A status comes from the last stored inspection; check_url has a single URL in full.

limit.description: Rows to return, 25 by default, 50 at most

site.description: The site: its id (a UUID) or its domain, such as example.com

name: list_pages
title: List a site's pages
